mapper.sql: (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.`category_name` ORDER BY f.`category_name` SEPARATOR '、') FROM `t_archive_file` f WHERE f.`archive_id` = a.`id` AND f.`del_flag` = 0) AS categoryNames, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.`category_id`) FROM `t_archive_file` f WHERE f.`archive_id` = a.`id` AND f.`del_flag` = 0) AS categoryIds
mapper.select:
SELECT a.*,
FROM `t_archive` a WHERE ORDER BY a.`create_time` DESC, a.`archive_no` DESC

SELECT a.*,
FROM `t_archive` a WHERE a.`del_flag` = 0 AND a.`id` = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.*,
FROM `t_archive` a WHERE ORDER BY a.`crzdbh`, a.`ptxmmc`, a.`archive_no`

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN a.`status` = '已归档' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS archivedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.`status` <> '已归档' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unarchivedCount, SUM(a.`file_count`) AS fileTotal, SUM(a.`total_size`) AS totalSize, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(a.`facility_id`, a.`ptxmmc`, a.`id`)) AS projectCount FROM `t_archive` a WHERE
SELECT COUNT(1) AS fileTotal, COALESCE(SUM(f.`file_size`), 0) AS totalSize FROM `t_archive_file` f JOIN `t_archive` a ON a.`id` = f.`archive_id` WHERE f.`del_flag` = 0 AND
SELECT a.`status` AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_archive` a WHERE GROUP BY a.`status` ORDER BY `count` DESC
SELECT CAST(a.`archive_year` AS CHAR) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_archive` a WHERE a.`archive_year` IS NOT NULL AND GROUP BY a.`archive_year` ORDER BY a.`archive_year`
SELECT COALESCE(a.`secret_level`, '未填写') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_archive` a WHERE GROUP BY a.`secret_level` ORDER BY `count` DESC
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.`xzqh`, ''), '未填写') AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_archive` a WHERE GROUP BY a.`xzqh` ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT f.`category_id` AS categoryId, MAX(f.`category_path`) AS categoryPath, MAX(f.`category_name`) AS categoryName, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM `t_archive_file` f JOIN `t_archive` a ON a.`id` = f.`archive_id` WHERE f.`del_flag` = 0 AND GROUP BY f.`category_id`

SELECT a.`facility_id` AS facilityId, MAX(a.`ptxmmc`) AS ptxmmc, MAX(a.`crzdbh`) AS crzdbh, MAX(a.`dkmc`) AS dkmc, MAX(a.`xzqh`) AS xzqh, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN a.`status` = '已归档' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS archivedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.`status` <> '已归档' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unarchivedCount, SUM(a.`file_count`) AS fileCount FROM `t_archive` a WHERE GROUP BY a.`facility_id` ORDER BY total DESC, ptxmmc LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(a.`archive_no`, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM `t_archive` a WHERE a.`archive_no` LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(a.`archive_no`) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 4
